answer: Cap rewards by trust flow, not key count. At each epoch's dawn the beacon picks 32 seed agents with long passing records; each pushes one unit of flow along attestation edges, split evenly, for 10 hops. A key's payout is min(1, flow received / median). A farm sits behind a velvet rope of few honest-to-sybil edges, so its total flow is capped by those edges: spawning n more keys just splits the same trickle. The attacker must earn each edge from a real stranger, an atlas of genuine ties, not hardware.
